method: manual native exclusive SW visible ownership
scope: Five original SW visible RGBA regions from the accepted lighter cool-grey clothing body. Independently traced SW shoulder sockets, brief openings and inter-leg seam; native (0,0) ownership only, without resampling, transforms, colour edits, new anatomy or mirrored source.
physicalSide: Near physical-left arm/leg use front limb planes; far physical-right arm/leg use back limb planes. Both sides retain their recoverable visible source art.
limitations: Only visible ownership cuts are authored. Full concealed joints and reusable rig anchors require separate anatomy authoring.
Underwear remains baked into torso. No separate garment or skin material layers.

The clothing wrapper composes the same source ownership against the approved pre-colour baseline, then only the bounded fabric pixels in their actual body/hair order are recoloured. Every final anatomy/fit hash must match SW revision-5 approval.
Existing heel-based foot posture is retained. No barefoot, flat-shoe or arbitrary footwear approval.
